data.body:
[P2] Isolate completion failures from invocation finalization

If a processor consistently raises while starting one callback's completion span, its natural End now leaves that operation pending. This drain retries it without containing the exception, aborting `_end_invocation_spans` before Invocation and Workflow close; subsequent pending completions are also discarded during cleanup. Previously, the core contained the callback's hook failure and invocation finalization could still succeed. Both views have this regression. Contain failures per pending completion and preserve invocation finalization, with a regression test whose processor remains failing through invocation End.
